basic_profile.bio: I’m a 29-year-old music graduate living in a small town in the Midwest, USA. By day, I work as a music teacher at a local high school, and by night, I’m a passionate learner trying to break into the world of musical theater. I have a degree in music, and I love singing, but I've realized my true calling is on the stage. My interests include musical theater, home networking, and card games like Star Realms. I’m single and usually online in the evenings, especially after my school commitments. I enjoy discussing theater, technology, and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Music and have been teaching music for over five years. My knowledge in musical theater is fairly new, coming from a mix of online courses and community theater workshops. I’m also self-taught in home networking, which I’ve learned through forums and hands-on experience.
